description: This file contains implementation of network device status management functions, including initialization, get/set parameter functions, validation, rollback, and commit operations for network device status parameters, with references to external configuration and schema buffers.

methods.name: CosaDmlNetworkDevicesStatusInit
methods.description: Initializes network device status parameters from NVRAM configurations.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves the boolean value of the 'Enabled' parameter.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets the boolean value of the 'Enabled' parameter.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves unsigned long parameters like PollingPeriod and ReportingPeriod.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets unsigned long parameters like PollingPeriod and ReportingPeriod.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves string parameters Schema and SchemaID buffers.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Validate
methods.description: Validates current parameter values before commit.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Rollback
methods.description: Reverts changes to previous valid state.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Commit
methods.description: Commits the current parameter changes to persistent storage.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Default_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves default unsigned long parameter values.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Default_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets default unsigned long parameter values.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Default_Validate
methods.description: Validates default parameter values before applying.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Default_Rollback
methods.description: Reverts default parameter changes to previous state.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Default_Commit
methods.description: Commits default parameter changes to persistent storage.
